text:
Alex R: Quick follow-up from the postmortem - we agreed to a small mitigation bundle for vendor-related failures (cloud control-plane blips + model-registry auth timeouts). Posting owners & suggested deadlines here so we can close the loop.

Maya S: I can pick cloud-side mitigations: validate contact matrix, escalate path, and a provider-side playbook. Target: 2026-04-06 for doc + contacts.

Devon K: I'll take the model-registry hardening work: immutable model pins, fallback endpoints, and validation tests. Planning to ship an RFC by 2026-04-04.

Lina T: I'll do auth provider work: token rotation telemetry, stricter retry/backoff, and a secondary auth provider evaluation. ETA for PR + eval: 2026-04-05.

Evan P: I'll ensure runbooks are updated and that the on-call has clear vendor escalation windows. I'll also add a short smoke that runs every Monday morning. ETA 2026-04-02.

ops-bot: New issues created: https://tracker.internal/INC-3001 (cloud contacts), INC-3002 (model-registry fallback), INC-3003 (auth telemetry). Owners set to Maya S, Devon K, Lina T. Links added to postmortem doc.

Alex R: Thanks. A couple of constraints: 1) we need a backup owner for each task, 2) weekly quick-check automation for tokens + registry health, 3) a small canary plan for model fallbacks.

Maya S: Backup for cloud tasks = "Infra team lead". I'll request a runbook walk-through from the provider rep and capture expected RTO/RPO.

Devon K: Canary plan: roll 1% of traffic to fallback endpoint with telemetry for output drift. I'll include a test harness in the model-registry repo and add a regression check.

Lina T: For token telemetry: add alert when refresh failures >0.3% over 10m and when token age > expected +30s. I'll also prototype a short circuit to force swap to backup auth if failure persists 3m.

Evan P: Weekly quick-check: will schedule a job to call auth refresh and list models; failures open an automated incident with a checklist.

Alex R: Can we get rough deadlines in the thread so PMs and execs can see progress? Suggest Maya 2026-04-06, Devon 2026-04-04, Lina 2026-04-05, Evan 2026-04-02. Agree?

Maya S: Confirmed 2026-04-06. I'll also ask for provider logs from 03/24 and add them to INC-3001 when available.

Devon K: Confirmed 2026-04-04 for RFC. Will include rollback script and runbook steps for fast revert.

Lina T: Confirmed 2026-04-05. Also asked security to audit token scopes for the model-registry integration.

Evan P: Confirmed 2026-04-02. Adding expected vendor response windows to runbook: 1) initial ack 1h, 2) triage 4h, 3) remediation plan 24h.

Alex R: Good. Another ask: let's add an entry in the postmortem index for recurring vendor-related patterns (auth + registry spikes). If it's appearing >2x in 6 months we escalate to vendor review.

Maya S: Agreed. I'll add a small table to the postmortem showing prior incidents & blast radius.

Devon K: For transparency, I'll open INC-3002 with a test harness link and a small dataset so folks can run locally.

Lina T: I'll open a vendor evaluation doc for a secondary auth provider with pros/cons and cost implications.

Evan P: Adding rotation policy: primary owner rotates monthly with a named backup. Will update issues to reflect primary+backup fields.

ops-bot: Calendar invite created: Vendor Dependency Review (recurring quarterly) 2026-04-20 09:00 PDT. Link: https://calendar.internal/e/vendor-review-2026-04-20

Alex R: One more operational note: include acceptance criteria for each mitigation (smoke pass, canary metrics within drift threshold, runbook steps verified). We'll close the follow-up only after acceptance criteria met.

Maya S: Adding acceptance criteria to INC-3001.

Devon K: Acceptance criteria added to INC-3002: canary pass + rollback tested.

Lina T: Acceptance criteria added to INC-3003: alerting in place + failover to backup auth verified.

Evan P: I'll mark the postmortem follow-up as 'in progress' and do the first-week check-in on 2026-04-07. If anything blocks earlier, ping #incidents.

Alex R: Thanks all. React :thumbsup: when you've updated your respective tickets. We'll reconvene after the first-week check-ins.
